summary.tldr: Pinterest Predicts 2026 outlines 21 data-backed trends across categories, with Gen Z and Millennials driving many aesthetics while Boomers and Gen X shape select food and travel shifts.
summary.executive_summary: Pinterest Predicts 2026 synthesizes internal, global English-language search signals to surface 21 emerging trends, benchmarked by normalized year-over-year search growth. The report highlights a wave of Gen Z and Millennial-led aesthetics spanning beauty, fashion, travel and home—from icy, blue-toned looks to bespoke fragrance layering and maximalist glamour. Counterbalancing these are cohort-specific moves such as Boomers and Gen X embracing a cabbage-forward food moment and Millennials and Boomers seeking mystical travel destinations. Collectively, the trends suggest a 2026 consumer landscape that prizes expressive styling, tactile novelty and experience-first travel, grounded in measurable search momentum.

expert_comment:
Pinterest’s 2026 signals resolve into an expressive, tactile consumer palette with verified momentum pulled from normalized year-over-year search growth (Sep 2024–Aug 2025 vs Sep 2023–Aug 2024). The Cool Blue thread shows multi-category adoption, spanning beauty and beverages (frosted make-up +150%; blue drinks aesthetic +55%). Experimental and cultural layering manifest in both beauty and home (avant garde make-up editorial +270%; afrobohemian home decor +220%). This points to demand for distinct visual narratives that can be merchandised coherently across categories.

In beauty and fragrance, growth concentrates in bespoke construction and editorial surfaces. “Niche perfume collection” rose sharply (+500%) among Gen Z and Millennials, while texture and tone cues accelerate (lace nails +215%; icy blue +50%). These patterns favor assortments designed for layering and play, supported by discovery-led formats and cool-toned color stories synchronized across product, content, and retail moments.

Travel and food split along actionable cohort lines that support differentiated positioning. Gen Z and Millennials are leaning into adrenaline tourism (adventure tourism +75%; auto racing events +85%), while Millennials and Boomers surge toward atmospheric destinations (Scotland Highlands aesthetic +465, the largest single-term travel increase reported; Faroe Islands aesthetic +95), reinforcing the report’s experience-first travel read. In food, Boomers and Gen X are driving a cabbage-forward pivot (cabbage dumplings +110%; golumpki soup +95%), enabling targeted menu, content, and partnership strategies without cross-cohort dilution.

Consumer attention in 2026 is spiking in two places: bespoke scent building (“niche perfume collection” +500%) and mystical travel (“Scotland Highlands aesthetic” +465%). Both are grounded in Pinterest’s global, English‑language search signals and highlight where cohorts are leaning next.  

What this means for digital leaders: search momentum is concentrating around expressive styling, tactile detail, and experience‑led travel across beauty, fashion, home, and tourism, with clear generational early adopters called out in the data. Pinterest’s methodology compares normalised searches from Sep 2024–Aug 2025 vs Sep 2023–Aug 2024, and identifies top generations contributing to growth. 

Data signals to watch:
- Blue‑toned, “Cool Blue” aesthetics led by Gen Z and Millennials: “frosted make‑up” +150%, “blue drinks aesthetic” +55%, “icy blue” +50%. 
- Scent stacking among Gen Z and Millennials: “niche perfume collection” +500%. 
- Lace textures moving quickly across categories: “lace nails” +215%. 
- Experimental beauty looks: “avant garde make‑up editorial” +270%. 
- Afro‑bohemian interiors: “afrobohemian home decor” +220%. 
- Mystic, atmospheric travel interest among Millennials and Boomers: “Scotland Highlands aesthetic” +465%, “Faroe Islands aesthetic” +95%. 
- Adrenaline‑led trips for Gen Z and Millennials: “adventure tourism” +75%, “auto racing events” +85%. 
- A cabbage‑forward food shift among Boomers and Gen X: “cabbage dumplings” +110%, “golumpki soup” +95%. 

How to read it: Pinterest Predicts 2026 surfaces cross‑category trends and highlights which generations are driving search growth, enabling teams to anchor planning and creative in concrete behavioral signals rather than guesswork. Sourcing: Pinterest internal, global English‑language search data; changes reflect normalised searches in Sep 2024–Aug 2025 vs Sep 2023–Aug 2024, with early adopters shown by generation.
